name: Kolhapuri Chappal Design No. 25-75 – Elegant Beige Color Traditional Footwear (With Box )
description:
Kolhapuri Chappal Design No. 25-75 – Elegant Beige Color Traditional Footwear
​Kolhapuri chappals are traditional handcrafted leather sandals originating from Kolhapur, India, renowned for their durability and intricate designs. The Design No. 25-75 in beige color embodies this rich heritage while offering a versatile and elegant footwear option.​
Key Features:


 	
Material: Crafted from high-quality leather, ensuring both comfort and longevity.​

 	
Design: Features traditional patterns and detailing characteristic of Kolhapuri craftsmanship, adding a touch of cultural authenticity

 	
Color: The neutral beige hue enhances its versatility, allowing it to complement a wide range of outfits and occasions.​

 	
Sole: Equipped with a sturdy, non-slip sole for reliable traction and support during extended wear

 	
Comfort: Designed for a comfortable fit, making it suitable for daily use as well as special events.​


This particular design seamlessly blends traditional aesthetics with modern style, making it a timeless addition to any wardrobe.
